topic: Describe a scene in nature in spatial order(按空间顺序描写一处自然景色)
genre: 描写文 / 写景(describe a landscape painting or photo in spatial order)
source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 1 Moving Forward:Writing in spatial order——按空间顺序(从左到右/从近到远)描写一幅风景画或一处自然景色。
prompt_cn: 请选择一幅你喜欢的风景画或一张自然照片,用英语写一段约80词的短文,按空间顺序(如从左到右、从近到远)描写其中的景色。要求:① 抓住最重要的细节;② 用表示方位的词语让画面有条理(in front of / on the left / in the distance 等);③ 结尾写出这处景色给你的整体感受。
prompt_en: Choose a landscape painting or a nature photo you like. Write a paragraph of about 80 words describing the scene in spatial order (e.g. from near to far, or from left to right). You should: 1) include the most important details; 2) use prepositions of place to organise the picture (in front of / on the left / in the distance); 3) end with the overall feeling the scene gives you.
points: 选定观察角度并抓住主要细节(A stream / trees / mountains …)
用方位词组织画面(in front of us / on the left / in the distance)
按空间顺序由近及远(或从左到右)展开
结尾点出整体感受(All these present a peaceful view of nature.)
model_essay: In front of us, a clear stream flows gently from the left to the far right through a green grassland. At our feet, wild flowers grow brightly on the bank. On the other side, tall trees stand strong and quiet. Further in the distance, a small palace rises against the hills, and the sun is setting beside it, casting a soft golden glow on the clouds above. All these details combine to present a peaceful and beautiful view of nature at dusk. Looking at it, I feel calm and full of hope.
model_translation: 在我们眼前,一条清澈的小溪从左边缓缓流向远处的右方,穿过一片绿色的草地。在我们脚边,野花在岸边明艳地盛开。河的另一边,高大的树木静静而挺拔。再往远处,一座小宫殿映衬着群山,夕阳正落在它旁边,为上方的云彩洒下柔和的金光。所有这些细节组合在一起,呈现出黄昏时分大自然宁静而美丽的景象。望着它,我感到平静,满怀希望。

rubric.criteria: 细节齐全:主要景物 + 方位组织 + 整体感受三要素到位
按统一的空间顺序(由近及远/从左到右)展开,行文连贯、画面清晰
方位词组与写景词汇准确多样,定语从句等句型运用得当,语法基本无误

required_structure: 起笔定位 In front of us, …
中景 On the other side, …
远景 Further in the distance, …
收束感受 All these present a peaceful view of nature.
key_expressions: In front of us, a clear stream flows from the left to the far right.
At our feet, wild flowers grow brightly on the bank.
Further in the distance, a small palace rises against the hills.
All these details present a peaceful view of nature at dusk.

high_sentences: In front of us, a clear stream flows gently from the left to the far right.
Further in the distance, a small palace rises against the hills.
The sun is setting beside it, casting a soft golden glow on the clouds above.
All these details combine to present a peaceful view of nature at dusk.

error_pairs.wrong: The trees stands on the left.
error_pairs.correct: The trees stand on the left.
error_pairs.note: 主语 trees 为复数,动词不加 s。

error_pairs.wrong: A stream which flows past the field it is clear.
error_pairs.correct: A stream which flows past the field is clear.
error_pairs.note: 定语从句后不再重复主语 it。

error_pairs.wrong: In the distance, a palace stand against the hills.
error_pairs.correct: In the distance, a palace stands against the hills.
error_pairs.note: 主语 a palace 第三人称单数,动词加 s。

paragraph_template:
【按空间顺序写景结构】
第1句 定位起笔:In front of us, …
第2句 近景:At our feet, …
第3句 中景:On the other side, …
第4句 远景:Further in the distance, …
第5句 收束感受:All these present a peaceful view of nature.
